name: thoughtsphere
description: ThoughtSphere is a modern note-taking web application that allows users to create, manage, and organize their thoughts efficiently. It includes secure API protection with rate limiting powered by Upstash, ensuring scalable and abuse-resistant performance. Designed with a clean UI and optimized backend architecture for reliability and speed.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend

author: Riaj Hasan Pranto
